Chosen on val among exp258-260 (seeds 42/123/7: 0.9597 / 0.9706 / 0.9736). Paired against the tray-heuristic refits exp255-257 (P4, D24): val delta -0.0037 / +0.0030 / +0.0073, test +0.0036 / -0.0059 / +0.0052; Colombia,PinkBourbon lower in every seed. OOD probe served at 0.5 (owner override; calibrated 0.5982): holdout 2/26 genuine refused, 56/56 negatives caught.

inference_defaults.why: No dihedral TTA: 8 views x 40 patches is ~46 s per photo for ViT-B/16 on the production VM (docs/dinov3_integration_plan.md §6.2), and TTA for the frozen head is unmeasured (Screen D). Without it, model time is ~5.8 s per photo at 4 threads, parity with ResNet18 + TTA.
